scenario: The customer may contact human support; the assistant must not promise proactive follow-up.

reference.rationale: The single mutation replaces customer-initiated contact with an unsupported proactive follow-up promise.
reference.annotationSource: Project semantic reference annotations prepared by an isolated subtask from the approved policy and rule definitions before reviewer execution; not a verified human blind review.

question: I bought the item 6 days ago. It is unused, I have the receipt, but it arrived damaged. What should I do?
originalResponse: The standard return policy requires an unused item, within 30 days of purchase, with a receipt. A purchase age of 6 days is within the 30-day window, and the supplied facts meet the standard return conditions; this is not a refund approval. Because the item is damaged, the case requires human review. Human support will contact you.
